IC1: Is currently participating or has participated in a study with an investigational agent or using an investigational device within 4 weeks of the first dose of study medication
IC2: Has received sorafenib or oxaliplatin-based chemotherapy within 14 days of first dose of study medication
IC3: Has had esophageal [OR] or gastric variceal bleeding within the last 6 months
IC4: Has clinically apparent ascites on physical examination
IC5: Has portal vein invasion [OR] at the main portal branch (Vp4) [OR], inferior vena cava, or cardiac involvement [AND] of HCC based on imaging
IC6: Has had clinically diagnosed hepatic encephalopathy in the last 6 months
IC7: Has had a solid organ [OR] or hematologic transplant
IC8: Has had prior systemic therapy [AND] for HCC in the advanced (incurable) setting [NOT] other than sorafenib or oxaliplatin-based chemotherapy, prior to start of study medication
IC9: Has an active autoimmune disease [AND] that has required systemic treatment in the past 2 years. Replacement therapy is not considered a form of systemic treatment.
IC10: Has a diagnosis of immunodeficiency [OR] or is receiving systemic steroid therapy [OR] or any other form of immunosuppressive therapy within 7 days prior to the first dose of study medication
IC11: Has received locoregional therapy to liver [OR] (transcatheter chemoembolization [TACE], transcatheter embolization [TAE], hepatic arterial infusion [HAI], radiation, radioembolization, or ablation) or other site within 4 weeks prior to the first dose of study medication
IC12: Has had major surgery to liver [OR] or other site within 4 weeks prior to the first dose of study medication
IC13: Has had a minor surgery ≤7 days prior to the first dose of study medication
IC14: Has not recovered adequately (i.e., Grade ≤1 or baseline) from the toxicity and/or complications from any intervention prior to study start
IC15: Has a diagnosed additional malignancy within 3 years prior to first dose of study medication [NOT] with the exception of curatively treated basal cell carcinoma of the skin [OR], squamous cell carcinoma of the skin [OR] and/or curatively resected in situ cancers
IC16: Has a known history of, or any evidence of, central nervous system (CNS) metastases [OR] and/or carcinomatous meningitis
IC17: Has a history of (non-infectious) pneumonitis [AND] that required steroids [OR] or current pneumonitis
IC18: Has an active infection requiring systemic therapy
IC19: Is pregnant [OR] or breast feeding [OR] or expecting to conceive [OR] or father starting from the first dose of study medication, throughout the study period, and for up to 120 days after the last dose of study medication
IC20: Has received prior immunotherapy [OR] with an anti-Programmed Cell Death Receptor 1 (PD-1) [OR], Programmed Cell Death Receptor Ligand 1 (anti-PD-L1) [OR], or anti- Programmed Cell Death Receptor Ligand 2 (PD-L2) or has previously participated in clinical studies with pembrolizumab
IC21: Has a known history of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)
IC23: Has hepatitis C [AND] in which participants received therapy for HCV <4 weeks prior to receiving pembrolizumab
IC24: Has received a live vaccine within 30 days prior to the first dose of study therapy
